elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Five File Explorer windows open and you can't find the right one?

[confident] Here's the fix. Use tabs in File Explorer.

[friendly] Press Control and T for a new tab. Control Tab switches between them. Drag a file onto a tab to move it.

[delighted] One window, every folder, one click apart.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
